meta_data.base_class: Fetch the schedule of a team participating in a <team-based professional sport> league - refers to competitive sports organized around teams that play season-based games within official leagues.

tool_template.name: <class>_team.get_schedule
tool_template.description: Fetches the schedule of the specified <class> team for the specified number of games in the given league.

num_of_games.description: Number of games for which to fetch the schedule.

location.description: The city or venue where games are to be held.

season.description: The season in which the <class> team plays, e.g., 2023-2024.

home_away_preference.description: Specify if the schedule should focus on 'home', 'away', or 'both' games for the <class> team.

day_filter.description: Optional filter for a specific day of the week, e.g., 'Saturday'.

time_format.description: Preferred time format for game schedules, either '12-hour' or '24-hour'.
